label: Side Pleat
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real photograph of a worn shirt back. I can see the horizontal yoke seam and two vertical pleat folds dropping from it, one over each shoulder blade, set roughly a third of the back width in from each armhole. The centre back between them is flat with no centre box pleat. A printed blue banner across the bottom reads 'REAR-SIDE PLEATS'. Count (2), position (off-centre, one per side, below the yoke) and the clean centre back all match the Side Pleat label.
